title: Fernwood Health Standup - HIPAA Audit Prep

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: Morning. The HIPAA audit is in three weeks, so let's use standup to track prep. Liam, where's the access log review?

transcript.speaker: Liam Fitzgerald
transcript.text: About halfway. I found two service accounts with broader database permissions than they need - the billing export job can read the entire patients table when it only needs three columns.

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: That needs to be locked down before the audit. Can you scope it down today?

transcript.speaker: Liam Fitzgerald
transcript.text: Yes, I'll create a restricted view and repoint the export job at it today.

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: Thanks. Ines, how's the policy documentation coming?

transcript.speaker: Ines Alvarez
transcript.text: The access control policy doc is done. I'm still waiting on legal to review the breach notification procedure - I followed up with them yesterday.

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: Let's get a hard date from legal, not just a follow-up. Can you push for a response by Friday?

transcript.speaker: Ines Alvarez
transcript.text: I'll ask for a commitment by Friday when I message them today.

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: I'm auditing our encryption-at-rest settings across all three databases this week and will report back Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Liam Fitzgerald
transcript.text: One question - does the audit cover the staging database too, or just production?

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: I actually don't know, let me check with the auditor and confirm scope.

transcript.speaker: Amara Okafor
transcript.text: Okay, let's keep moving. Thanks all.

summary_key_points: Found overly broad database permissions on the billing export service account
Access control policy documentation is complete; breach notification procedure awaits legal review
Encryption-at-rest settings are being audited across all three databases
It's unclear whether the audit covers the staging database

action_items.task: Scope down the billing export service account to a restricted view today
Get a commitment from legal for a Friday review of the breach notification procedure
Audit encryption-at-rest settings across all three databases and report back Thursday

decisions: Push legal for a hard Friday deadline instead of an open-ended follow-up
open_questions: Does the HIPAA audit scope include the staging database or only production?
